thesis: The page is a wall under a twelve-inch knife: every pass skims a section flatter and paler, until the rough gray board at the top is primed white at the form.

signature.name: Feathered Knife Pass
signature.summary: A tapered blade-shaped wipe with a ragged feathered trailing edge sweeps across content and leaves it smoother: it feathers the square-cut patch frame around the hero photo into the wall, draws the feathered seams between bands, skims each price ledger row, swipes test-board review cards, and lays the final smooth pass under the quote form and footer.

palette.family: Gypsum Gray + Primer White + Spruce Knife

layoutMoves: background steps from gypsum gray (#D5D6D2) at the top to primer white (#F3F0E8 then #FFFFFF) at the form, one step per band
feathered SVG knife-edge seams between bands instead of straight edges, the feather getting finer down the page
price ledger as full-width ruled rows with tabular numerals, each row skimmed by the blade on entry

motion.intro: 0.9s: the knife blade sweeps once left to right across the hero, feathering the square-cut patch frame of the photo into the wall; skippable, h1 readable from frame 0
stories: coats: pinned >=640px, 4 steps (cut and back, tape, coats 1-3, sand and prime); the wall panel is wiped smoother at each step, verb wipe
motion.hover: a 2px spruce knife-edge underline that wipes in from the left with scaleX and a feathered tail
